notes:
Summary: Lighthouse Archival Works runs a multi-decade digital archive for cultural institutions. Heavy RAG use: semantic search + document-level rerank for discovery and reference chat. Trialing vector DBs and connector options — main concerns are index scale (hundreds of millions of passages), upsert latency for nightly ingest windows, and per-query cost for cross-encoder rerank.

Recent call (2026-02-15): AE/Maya + SE/Carlos demoed Redwood Dedicated routing + prefix caching. Customer quote: 'We need predictable per-query economics — if rerank costs spike, downstream licensing and archive access margins collapse.' Wants clear unit cost model.

Technical needs (customer language):
- Corpus: ~500M passages (~10TB of embedding data after dimensionality/quantization).
- Ingest: 1M new/updated passages per day during peak ingest windows; requires bulk import + idempotent upserts.
- QPS target: 150–250 sustained global QPS; spike tolerance to 600 QPS for event-driven lookups.
- Latency SLOs: retrieval (ANN) 50–120ms p95; end-to-end search+rerank <350–450ms p95 depending on rerank model.
- Cost sensitivity: prefer batching + cheap ANN for first-pass; use small cross-encoder only on top-50 to control compute.

Vector DB / connector requirements the customer enumerated:
- Bulk ingest API with parallel shards and resumable uploads; support for delta-only upserts and metadata-preserving reimports.
- Multi-namespace/tenant isolation plus tag-based metadata filters for faceted search.
- Pluggable ANN algorithms (HNSW, IVFPQ) and ability to export index stats (cardinality, avg-degree, mem usage).
- Support for cosine and L2 metrics and stable vector dims; clear quantization/float16 guidance.
- Low per-upsert latency path and ability to route hot documents to in-memory cache (TTL).
- Connector must expose top-K with raw similarity scores and optionally payload filtering on boolean/term fields.
- Operational hooks: health, compaction events, index rebuild notifications, and cost attribution per-query.

POC acceptance criteria:
- End-to-end e2e demo on 50k sample corpus: p95 retrieval <120ms; rerank (small cross-encoder on top-50) <300ms additional; total p95 <420ms.
- Sustained QPS 200 for 10-minute window without >1% error rate.
- Ingest: 200k docs/hour ingest with idempotency and consistent shard distribution.
- Security: SAML SSO, KMS integration demo, audit log export to S3.

Preferred tech stack and models:
- First-pass dense retrieval embeddings: open 1536-d model (customer is evaluating custom finetuned embedder).
- Rerank: distilled cross-encoder for top-50 (cost-aware), fallback lexical BM25 via Elastic for very short queries.
- Vector stores under evaluation: Pinecone, Weaviate, Elastic vector search, in-house pgvector. Redwood integration should provide connector parity and a migration path.

Sales notes / commercial posture:
- High likelihood to sign for Dedicated or Private if perf and security gates pass.
- Wants clear pricing for dedicated reserved capacity vs burst usage.
- Procurement expects enterprise SLA and SOC2/ISO references in vendor pack.

Call-to-action: deliver connector throughput report + sample cost-per-query modeling for their 500M corpus by next call.
